caption:
बॉस! कीर्ति सुरेश की नई फिल्म का तो बॉक्स ऑफिस पर बुरा हाल हो गया है! 😱

Tamil courtroom drama फिल्म Sathyavan Savithiri इस हफ्ते थिएटर्स में चुपचाप रिलीज हुई थी।
Mammootty और Dhanush की फिल्म OM के साथ क्लैश की वजह से ये फिल्म पूरी तरह दब गई।
फिल्म में कीर्ति सुरेश ने एक amateur lawyer का रोल निभाया है जो अपने पति को मर्डर केस से बचाने की कोशिश करती है।
Mysskin ने फिल्म में उनके सामने senior lawyer का रोल निभाया है और Praveen S Vijay ने इसे लिखा और डायरेक्ट किया है।
फिल्म ने अपने opening day पर 504 shows में सिर्फ 21 lakh रुपये कमाए हैं और occupancy rate महज 13% रहा।
इसका India gross collection 24.78 lakh रुपये रहा है और ये कोविड के बाद कीर्ति सुरेश की सबसे low opening है!
Raghu Thatha ने opening day पर 22 lakh कमाए थे, और ये फिल्म उससे भी पीछे रह गई है।
क्या आपने Sathyavan Savithiri फिल्म देखी है? 🍿

ctx.title: Sathyavan Savithiri Box Office Day 1: Keerthy Suresh Registers Her Lowest Opening Day Post-COVID
ctx.summary:
Keerthy Suresh's latest Tamil film, Sathyavan Savithiri, got lost in a crowded release weekend. This led to the actress registering her lowest opening post-COVID.  
 The post  Sathyavan Savithiri Box Office Day 1: Keerthy Suresh Registers Her Lowest Opening Day Post-COVID  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Keerthy Suresh and Mysskin-starrer Sathyavan Savithiri quietly released in theatres this weekend. However, the Tamil courtroom drama got lost in a sea of releases. The film clashed at the Kollywood box office with the biggie OM, which starred Mammootty and Dhanush in the lead. As a result, amid the OM wave, Sathyavan Savithiri saw disappointing opening numbers.
Keerthy Suresh has been impressive with her script selections of late. Moving away from playing typical “heroine” roles, she has been choosing strong, character-driven roles that drive the narrative. In her latest film, she plays an amateur lawyer who has the mammoth task of saving her husband after he is accused of murder. Opposite her is a senior lawyer essayed by Mysskin. The film’s trailer promised an engaging showcase of the two lawyers in the courtroom as the case intensifies with every argument.
Unfortunately, the case did not get as exciting at the box office. The film only earned 21 lakh on its opening day across 504 shows. The film saw an occupancy rate of just 13% . This brings the film’s India gross collection to 24.78 lakh .
With a disappointing and disastrous start, Sathyavan Savithiri has recorded Keerthy Suresh ‘s lowest opening since COVID-19. It has not even made it to her top 10 opening day collections since COVID. The film has earned less than her movie Raghu Thatha, which earned 22 lakh on its opening day.

Written and directed by debutant Praveen S Vijay, Sathyavan Savithiri also features Bala Saravanan, Shilpa Manjunath, Deepa Shankar, Madhusudhanan, R Sundarrajan, Maala Parvathi, and others. Sam CS has composed the music, while Arul Vincent handles cinematography and Prasanna GK is the editor. The film was released in theaters on November 20.
